explore-pol.title: Match the polarization
explore-pol.prompt: Turn the receiving antenna to get the full signal.
explore-pol.success: Vertical to vertical: full strength. Cross-polarized, the signal was about 20 dB weaker.

explore-iso.title: The isotropic radiator
explore-iso.prompt: Switch to the isotropic antenna and look at its shape.
explore-iso.success: A perfect sphere: equal in every direction. The dipole's doughnut is squashed off its ends.
